jobs.occupation: Research and Technology Composite Engineer (d/f/m) (Betriebstechniker/in)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support Airbus we are looking for a

Research and Technology Composite Engineer (d/f/m)

An open position for a Composite Engineer has arisen within the Composite Technology team for Central Manufacturing Engineering inside Airbus Aerostructures in Stade. This transnational team is maturing new technologies in R&T in order to secure, improve, and ramp up both legacy and future aircraft programs.

Your location

With its 2,500 employees, the Stade plant is a constantly growing producer of complex CFRP components. All vertical stabilizers for Airbus commercial aircraft, the A400M and various individual parts from the Airbus programs come from Stade. Even in times of industrial change, the Stade plant wants to maintain its position as market leader for complex CFRP components for the aviation industry - with a powerful strategy in the areas of processes, products and people. Stade offers you a modern working environment, combined with a high quality of life in the region and proximity to Hamburg.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- To identify the needs from the customer (plants, new programs) and deliver solutions through the set-up of R&T projects in transnational context.
- To support & validate developments with Experts, Industrial and Digital Architects.
- To develop & implement improvements to Composite processes & Technologies.
- To plan and perform physical trials and developments to enable maturation and validation of processes, materials and technologies , including robust data capture and analysis.
- To collaborate with (and manage) partners such as Technological centres or suppliers for new developments

Desired skills and qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree for materials, manufacturing systems or similar
- First experience in managing trials in shopfloor environment, composite manufacturing process and project management
- Fluent English and German skills
- Highly motivated and engaged, very high attitude for working independently and open minded for new developments
- Being creative and passion for working in a transnational technical environment
- Interest to work technically on a product and a process

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

jobs.occupation: Global Head of Strategy & Real Estate (Fachwirt/in - Facility-Management)
jobs.description:
Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

This is one of the most strategically significant roles in the new CREM structure — and in many respects the strategic right hand of the Head of CREM. As Head of Strategy & Real Estate, you will build and lead the capability that connects Merck's business direction to its global real estate portfolio: translating corporate strategy into actionable portfolio plans, owning the business partnering relationships with sector leadership, and overseeing the execution of transactions across EMEA, AMER and APAC.
This is a newly created function. Portfolio strategy, proactive planning and workplace strategy do not currently exist in a mature form within Merck's real estate organisation — you will establish them. Transactions capability exists and is largely retained; your mandate is to elevate it from reactive execution to strategically-led delivery.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Portfolio Strategy: Lead the development and annual refresh of CREM's Real Estate Plan of Record — translating business growth, consolidation and transformation requirements into a multi-year portfolio strategy with clear priorities, scenarios and business cases. Own portfolio optimisation as the function's primary strategic output.
- Business Partnering: Serve as a senior strategic partner to business sector leads across Healthcare, Life Science and Electronics — embedding CRE into business planning cycles before decisions are made, not after. Build trusted relationships that position CREM as a value-creating partner.
- M&A Support – Lead on all aspects of Real Estate and FM due diligence to support Merck M&A activity, managing cross-border due diligence and master planning to capture portfolio synergies, mitigate risk, and prepare portfolio integration plan. Once M&A transaction is signed then lead the implementation of all portfolio and service delivery integration activities.
- Workplace & Occupancy Strategy: Own workplace and occupancy planning strategy at a global level — setting standards, guiding space utilisation principles and ensuring portfolio decisions reflect both business needs and efficiency targets.
- Market Intelligence: Oversee the function's market intelligence capability — leveraging external partners and broker relationships to ensure portfolio decisions are backed by real market insight, proactive lease expiry management and benchmarked market data.
- Transaction Oversight: Provide strategic direction and oversight to the regional Transaction Managers across EMEA, AMER and APAC — ensuring all transactions are strategy-led, governed consistently and executed to a high standard. Maintain sufficient transaction expertise to provide cover and resource flexibility where needed.

One of the most operationally significant roles in the new CREM structure, the Global Head of Facilities Management is responsible for leading and transforming Merck's facilities and workplace management function across a global portfolio of 340+ locations and 4.3 million m² — encompassing offices, standalone labs, warehouses and selected soft services at manufacturing sites across more than 60 countries.
This is a dual-focus role requiring transformational vision and strict operational leadership. You will consolidate our existing FM foundation into a high-performing, data-informed ecosystem designed to minimise operational vulnerability. Through uniform service delivery standards and a consolidated regional IFM vendor model, you will drive process efficiency, strengthen risk controls, and unlock strategic business value across Merck's global footprint.

- FM Strategy & Vision: Define and own the global FM strategy for CREM — establishing a unified vision, service delivery model and operating standards across all asset classes and geographies, aligned to Merck's broader corporate objectives.

- Stakeholder Engagement: Build trusted relationships with business sector leads, site managers and senior Merck stakeholders — positioning FM as a value-creating partner and ensuring the function is responsive to business needs.

- FM Budget Responsibility: Manage the global FM budget, allocating, monitoring, and optimising operational and capital expenditure (OpEx/CapEx) across the portfolio to ensure cost-efficiency, regulatory compliance, and alignment with corporate financial objectives.
- Budget Authority: Hold direct budget authority for FM vendor contracts and operational spend across the full scope — managing significant global FM expenditure, driving cost efficiency and ensuring financial transparency across the function.
- Standards & Compliance: Establish and enforce binding global FM standards — covering vendor protocols, preventative maintenance schedules, H&S compliance, SLAs and performance penalties. Ensure consistent application across all geographies.
- Manufacturing FM: Oversee the delivery of selected soft FM services at manufacturing sites — working in close collaboration with the Quality & Compliance Lead to ensure service delivery meets the specific operational and regulatory requirements of Merck's manufacturing environments.
- Performance Management: Establish and own the FM KPI framework — tracking performance against industry benchmarks (IFMA, RICS), driving continuous improvement and ensuring data-driven decision making is embedded across the function to achieve operational excellence.
- People Management: Lead, develop and inspire a global FM organisation — including four Regional Heads and the Quality & Compliance Lead — through a period of significant organisational change, building a high-performance culture.

jobs.description:
Constructor University (formerly Jacobs University) is a private, state-accredited, English-language university in Bremen. We offer Bachelor, Master, and PhD programs in three schools: School of Science, School of Computer Science and Engineering, and School of Business, Social and Decision Sciences. Our principles are first-class teaching and research, international diversity, and transdisciplinary cooperation. According to the 2024 Times Higher Education (THE) World University Rankings, Constructor University is among the top 25 percent out of more than 1.900 universities worldwide and is ranked as the second most international university in the world. As an international university, we attract highly talented and open-minded students from all over the world. Currently, 2000 students from 120 nations live and study on our residential campus.
Constructor University invites applications from interested candidates for the following position, to be filled ideally by February 2027:
 

Assistant / Associate Professor of Chemistry in "Advanced Materials Science" (m/f/d)
(full time; 38.5 hrs./week; tenure track)

Your Responsibilities:  

The School of Science is particularly interested in candidates with a strong focus on the synthesis and physicochemical characterization of Advanced Materials. In this context, interdisciplinary research is strongly encouraged. Ideal candidates combine experimental and computational approaches. The successful candidate will be expected to maintain a cutting-edge externally funded research program at the forefront of the field which complements existing research groups in the School of Science.

The successful candidate will conduct teaching in Chemistry and Advanced Materials Science (lectures and laboratory courses) at the BSc, MSc, and PhD level. They will be expected to take a pivotal role in the new MSc program “Advanced Materials” with their research experience and via the development and implementation of innovative, pedagogically sound approaches to online, hybrid and in-person teaching and learning. This will also include the advising of students on their studies, and the supervision of Bachelor, Master and PhD theses and research projects.

The university is highly supportive of junior faculty, providing both formal and informal mentoring, administrative support, as well as a flexible budget for establishing an internationally visible research group. Several opportunities exist to develop multidisciplinary research projects in collaboration with other research groups or our industrial partners and to leverage existing research facilities like a clean room, an X-ray diffractometer and a compute cluster.

Your Qualifications:  

- PhD degree in the field of Chemistry or Materials Science.
- Strong publication record in relevant international journals
- Documented research activities in the field of Advanced Materials Science
- Experience in the acquisition of Third-Party funding
- Experience in successful teaching in international and diverse environments, with an interest in applying innovative teaching and learning approaches.
- Intercultural experience and competence
- Responsible, self-motivated person able to work independently and as a part of a team
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, the language of instruction and communication on campus
- Ideally, the successful candidate should be eligible for an ERC starting grant (assistant level) or an ERC consolidator grant (associate level).

jobs.occupation: Fleet Personnel Officer / Crew Management (m/w/d) - Hamburg - Hybrid (Personalreferent/in)
jobs.description:
Our client is an internationally operating Shipmanagement Company based in Hamburg.

Your next move in international shipping
For our client, an internationally operating company within the maritime industry, we are looking for an experienced and well-organized Fleet Personnel Officer (m/f/d) to join the team in Hamburg.
Our client is active in the management and operation of a mixed Fleet and LNG vessels and operates in a highly international environment where reliability, safety and high operational standards are essential. In this role, you will take responsibility for the crew management of an assigned fleet and ensure that vessels are staffed efficiently, reliably and in accordance with all relevant requirements.

Fleet Personnel Officer / Crew Management (m/w/d) - Hamburg - Hybrid

- Take ownership of the crew management and manning of your assigned vessels
- Ensure that vessels are staffed in line with regulatory requirements, crew matrices, qualifications and client-specific standards
- Plan and coordinate crew rotations, reliefs and replacements
- Identify suitable alternatives and solutions to ensure uninterrupted vessel operations
- Coordinate closely with seafarers, internal departments, manning partners and other international stakeholders
- Monitor upcoming crew requirements and proactively address potential staffing challenges
- Maintain accurate personnel and crew-related documentation
- Contribute to efficient and professional crew operations within a highly international environment
- A completed commercial qualification, degree or comparable professional background
- Previous experience in Crew Management, Crew Operations, Fleet Personnel or a similar maritime position
- A background in shipping is highly desirable; experience at sea is an advantage
- Good understanding of crew requirements, seafarer qualifications and relevant maritime regulations
- Strong organizational and planning skills, even when dealing with multiple priorities at the same time
- A structured, proactive and solution-oriented approach
- Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with international stakeholders
- Very good written and spoken English
- Confident use of MS Office and common digital tools
- A responsible position with your own area of responsibility
- An international working environment within the maritime and LNG sector
- A varied role with close contact to vessels, crews and international business partners
- A supportive and collaborative team with flat hierarchies and short decision-making processes
- Flexible working hours and a hybrid working model
- The possibility to work remotely for part of the month, subject to the applicable company arrangements
- Up to 30 days of annual leave, depending on length of service
- A competitive salary and attractive additional benefits
- A range of benefits to choose from, including support for public transport, bike leasing, fitness, childcare and meals
- A stable and future-oriented working environment with opportunities for professional development
